explanation: Close encounter between massive bodies 1 (10.5 Msun) and 3 (5.09 Msun) drives integration error. Distance drops from ~0.49 at step25 to 0.142 at step26, below softening 0.3, so potential deepens rapidly to -584. Reducing dt to 0.001 eliminates violation, confirming timestep/substep logic inadequacy for close approach.
